<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

html, body { margin:0; }

#ee_divRoot h1,#ee_divRoot h2,#ee_divRoot h3,#ee_divRoot p,#ee_divRoot pre { margin:0; }
#ee_divRoot h1 { font:750 clamp(28px,5vw,48px)/1.12 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot h2 { font:720 clamp(21px,3vw,30px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot h3 { font:700 19px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot pre { white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; font:14px/1.55 ui-monospace,monospace; }
#ee_divRoot code { overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] {
position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; width:100% !important; height:auto !important; overflow:visible !important;
}
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] > div:has(> table) { position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; height:auto !important; width:100% !important; overflow:visible !important; }

:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] td { padding:0; line-height:1.55; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
#ee_page { width:100% !important; }
#ee_wrap { max-width:1120px; margin-inline:auto; padding:clamp(16px,4vw,40px); }
#ee_support { padding:clamp(22px,5vw,54px) max(16px,calc((100% - 1040px)/2)); }
#ee_contactSupport,
#ee_aPageStillLooksUnchanged,
#ee_aPageLoadsButAnImageDoes { border:1px solid #e3dff2; border-radius:12px; padding:clamp(15px,3vw,24px); margin-block:14px; }
#ee_support2,
#ee_findAnswersToCommonQuestionsAboutEditing,
#ee_contactSupport2,
#ee_email,
#ee_supportEpageDev,
#ee_includeTheEpageStudioOrEserverVersion,

#ee_emailSupportEpageDevIncludeTheEpage,

control.text: Find answers to common questions about editing and publishing ePage projects.
. Include the ePage Studio or eServer version, the affected page URL, and steps to reproduce the issue. Remove passwords and private keys from attachments.
Refresh the browser and open the page directly. Check whether the URL points to the expected project and page directory.
A page loads but an image does not
Open the image URL directly and check that it returns an image. Verify the asset name, the project listing, and eServer file-access settings.
